========================================
Attribute-like macros in declaration specifiers
========================================

__IO uint32_t ISER[1];
__STATIC_INLINE int clip(int x) { return x; }
VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debugCallback(void *ud);
int WINAPI wWinMain(void *h, void *p, void *c, int s);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (function_definition
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (identifier))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))))

========================================
Calling-convention macro as a type position
========================================

NAPI_CDECL baz(int a);
CALLBACK int handler(void);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))))

========================================
Diagnostic pragma macros stay statements
========================================

void f(void) {
  __diag_push();
  __diag_ignore("-Wunused");
  work();
  __diag_pop();
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (primitive_type))))
    (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list
            (string_literal
              (string_content)))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          (identifier)
          (argument_list))))))
